item.title: How to serve static files in Express
item.description: Serving static files is fundamental for delivering CSS, JavaScript, images, and other assets in Express applications without writing custom route handlers. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve configured static file serving for countless web applications. The most efficient approach is using Express’s built-in express.static middleware to serve files from designated directories. This provides automatic MIME type detection, caching headers, and security features for optimal asset delivery.
